item.title: Morocco Extends Free Land Registration in 29 Zones
item.description: Morocco’s Official Gazette issue 7547 extends free land registration in 29 zones, lets governors cut local-debt enforcement costs, approves the Marchica lagoon plan, and clears a cancer-care software merger with binding conditions.

item.title: Morocco Licenses 7 Seed and Plant Sellers, Then Makes Them Report Sales
item.description: Seven seed and plant companies get five-year licences with mandatory sales reporting to the food safety office, and the Marchica 1 marina gets its operating rules. Here is what Morocco’s Official Gazette No. 7540 means for Moroccans abroad and outside observers.
